reviewer_role: Judge C — ADHD Product & Human-Centred Design Specialist

strengths.evidence: Prompt and filters ban streak-lost, overdue, behind, and lazy framing; verified across 128 swarm test cases in docs/bench-results/voice-agent-swarm.json

strengths.claim: Pause tolerance tuned for neurodivergent hesitation
strengths.evidence: FastSocket holds open 2.2s conversational pauses without cutting off user mid-thought; verified in tests/unit/fastSocket.test.ts
Transforms overwhelming 15-item brain dumps into single 2-minute actionable steps while parking remaining tasks in reversible Today list

defects.repro: Default voice volume relies entirely on system hardware slider rather than in-app ducking controls

missing_evidence: Formal longitudinal clinical wellbeing study with diagnosed ADHD participants (synthetic roleplay personas used for engineering benchmarks)
one_reason_to_reject: Cannot claim clinical medical validation or diagnostic efficacy under health regulatory standards
one_compelling_reason_to_award: Truly understands ADHD task initiation paralysis: asks less, does more, and provides immediate, non-judgmental momentum
